description: JavaScript code for TinyMCE plugin template management, including loading templates, selecting, inserting, and fetching template content.

methods.name: loadTemplatePaths
methods.description: Loads template paths from parameters or external list and populates the selection element.

methods.name: selectTemplate
methods.description: Loads selected template content into the editor and updates description display.

methods.name: insertTemplate
methods.description: Inserts the selected template content into the editor.

methods.name: getFileContents
methods.description: Fetches the content of a file via synchronous AJAX request.

methods.name: resizeInputs
methods.description: Adjusts the size of input elements based on window size.
